data.name: Elsiya
data.gender_notes: Elsiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'als' meaning 'moon' and the suffix 'ya' meaning 'light'. Refers to the gentle, calming influence of the moon. The name Elsiya carries the meaning “Moon Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Elsiya usually hope their child will grow to embody moon light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the nurturing and soothing nature of Allah.
data.etymology: Elsiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elsiya total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: اليسيا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الفتاة الحسناء الجميلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اليسيا هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل أجنبي، وقد ورد في بعض المراجع أنه من الأسماء التي تعني الفتاة الحسناء الجميلة، وقد أخذت بعض الأسماء العربية التي تعبر عن الجمال والصفاء، مثل يسرى وليساء، ولكنه غير وارد في القرآن الكريم أو الحديث النبوي الشريف.

in_urdu.name: ایلسیا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایلسیا ایک غیر ملکی मूल کا اسم علم مؤنث ہے، جو کچھ مراجع میں خوبصورت اور حسین لڑکی کے معنی میں آیا ہے، جو عربی زبان کے کچھ ناموں جیسے يسرى وليساء کی طرح جمال اور صفائی کا اظہار کرتے ہیں، لیکن یہ قرآن کریم یا حدیث نبوی شریف میں نہیں آیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: एलिसिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: एलिसिया एक विदेशी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो कुछ संदर्भों में सुंदर और आकर्षक लड़की के अर्थ में आता है, जो अरबी भाषा के कुछ नामों जैसे कि यसरى और लिसा की तरह सौंदर्य और पवित्रता को व्यक्त करता है, लेकिन यह कुरआन या हदीस में नहीं मिलता है।

data.cultural_impact: The name Elsiya holds significant cultural value in Muslim communities, as the moon is often referenced in Islamic literature and traditions. The annual Islamic celebration of Eid al-Fitr, marking the end of Ramadan, coincides with the beginning of the lunar month, signifying the importance of the moon in Islamic culture. A name like Elsiya is a constant reminder of this connection.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Elsiya carries a powerful spiritual significance, representing the tranquility and the stable influence of the moon upon one's inner self. The moon is a reminder that, like its phases, individuals experience growth and change throughout their lives. It also signifies the presence of an unchanging divine power guiding one through the ups and downs, providing a sense of comfort and reassurance.
